FortiADC-KVM # config load-balance virtual-server
  edit "LAB_VS_SMTP"
    set status disable
    set interface port2
    set ip 203.0.113.10
    set port 25
    set load-balance-profile LB_PROF_TCP
    set load-balance-method LB_METHOD_ROUND_ROBIN
    set load-balance-pool LAB_POOL_SMTP
    set traffic-log enable
  next
end

FortiADC-KVM #
